basis: Skeletal dysplasia, retinal degeneration and neurodevelopmental impairment define it; sensorineural hearing loss is another core feature, placed in involved because primary is capped at three.

decisions.neurologic: primary: microcephaly and intellectual disability are defining neurologic abnormalities.
decisions.otologic: involved: sensorineural hearing loss is a defining feature; the three-primary cap requires assigning one defining axis to involved.

basis: Primary sweat-gland chloride transport dysfunction; direct salt and water imbalance causes hypernatremic dehydration in 5/7 patients (~71%).

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: involved: systemic electrolyte disturbance follows sweat-gland dysfunction; hypernatremic dehydration occurs in 5/7 (~71%).

basis: Mitochondrial disease defined by lactic acidosis, cardiomyopathy and developmental impairment; optic atrophy occurs in 30-79%. Effusions do not establish direct pulmonary damage.

decisions.neurologic: primary: global developmental delay is explicitly defining; encephalopathy, intellectual disability and seizures also occur in 30-79%.

basis: Callosal agenesis, intellectual disability and limb malformations define it; hypospadias affects the urethra in 10/18 (~56%). Cardiac anomalies occur in only 5/22 (~23%).

decisions.renal: involved: hypospadias is a structural urethral malformation, explicitly within the renal axis, reported in 10/18 (~56%).

basis: RAPSN-related neuromuscular-junction dysfunction causes akinesia and contractures; cleft palate occurs in 1/2. Respiratory insufficiency in 2/2 does not establish intrinsic lung damage.

decisions.pulmonary: none: respiratory insufficiency in 2/2 can arise from neuromuscular weakness; pulmonary hypoplasia or other direct lung pathology is not documented for this subtype.

basis: Defining cystic dysplasia affects kidneys and pancreas. Situs reversal alone is not damage; bowed limbs in a descriptive synonym lack established severity and frequency.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: bowed lower limbs appear in a descriptive synonym, without evidence establishing damaging skeletal disease or its usual frequency.

basis: Primary malignant bone tumour; pulmonary metastatic occupation develops in roughly one-third or more over the disease course, although estimates vary.

decisions.pulmonary: involved: lung metastases directly occupy pulmonary tissue and occur in approximately 30% or more over the usual course of this aggressive bone sarcoma.

basis: Neurodevelopmental impairment and thoracic hypoplasia define it; quantitative IgA deficiency in 11/11 supports common humoral immune dysfunction. Pigment spots do not establish skin damage.

decisions.infectious_immune: involved: decreased IgA in 11/11 supports a common quantitative humoral immune deficit; clinical severity remains uncertain.

basis: Inherited phospholipid metabolism disorder with spinal and motor axonal degeneration; muscle atrophy in 30-79% reflects denervation rather than an intrinsic muscle disorder.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: distal wasting accompanies motor axonal neuropathy and is neurogenic; no separate intrinsic muscle or skeletal pathology is established.

basis: Autoinflammatory skin and bowel disease defines it; structural aortic coarctation and hypertension occur in 1/1 annotated patient, supporting cardiovascular involvement with limited precision.

decisions.cardiovascular: involved: coarctation and hypertension are documented in 1/1; the supplied frequency supports inclusion, although a singleton gives uncertain population frequency.
